workflow: A runtime stores special immutable records in static storage that lacks the full layout expected for ordinary collectible objects.
The record type is marked for garbage-collection traversal without excluding those special records.
Collection invokes the type’s traversal logic on a special record and reads fields beyond its valid bounds.
Memory-safety instrumentation detects the out-of-bounds read and terminates the process during cleanup instead of skipping the noncollectible record.
summary: Garbage-collector traversal overruns undersized static records
decision_reason: The failure mechanism is materially identical: special statically allocated records are treated as ordinary garbage-collectible objects, so traversal reads beyond their valid storage and crashes during collection.
